text: A recognition signal is a signal where a person, a ship, an airplane or something else is recognized. They can be used during war or can be used to help the police recognize each other during undercover operations. It can also be used in biology to signal that a molecule or chemical is to be bound to another molecule.
title: Recognition signal

text: The Eretz Israel Museum is an archeological, historical and anthropological museum in Tel Aviv. It is dedicated to history of Jewish life in the Land of Israel before 1948. The museum has some pavilions and a large archaeological park.
title: Eretz Israel Museum

text: Dutch filmmaker Theo van Gogh was murdered by Mohammed Bouyeri in Amsterdam East, Netherlands in broad daylight. The director's last words, according to eyewitnesses, were "Mercy mercy! We can talk about this!"
title: Assassination of Theo van Gogh

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Avening is a village and civil parish in Gloucestershire, England. It is in the Cotswold district, north of the town of Tetbury. The village had a population of 1,031 at the 2011 census. Avening dates back to the Saxon period. The village later grew around its church and water-powered mills. Cloth making became important in the area during the 17th century. Avening was recorded in the Domesday Book in 1086. At that time it had 60 households and five mills. The Church of the Holy Cross dates mainly from the late 11th century and is a Grade I listed building.
title: Avening

text: “She was so old,” explained the Witch of the North, “that she dried up quickly in the sun. That is the end of her. But the silver shoes are yours, and you shall have them to wear.” She reached down and picked up the shoes, and after shaking the dust out of them handed them to Dorothy.
title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz

verses.text: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
